name: castle_top_seams
comment: The agreed photos of the seams between the castle rooftops' rooms (R1 seventh round, CLAUDE.md 'Uma revisao so'): every door of every painted room in use in seeds 1 and 7, at night in the rain, Link a little inside it and the room's enemies gone (step doorshots, after the level's name has faded); python tools/test/seam_sheet.py castle_top_seams puts the two sides of each seam together.
